d: The front part of the hall widens to the right and left to semi-circular spacious niches, whose wall architecture is partly covered with mirrors. Some casually placed comfortable seating furniture. Candlelight on the walls. To the middle, in the narrower part of the hall, two steps lead up. In the left side wall is the door to the dining room. In the right side wall leads a wallpaper door to the stage of the castle theatre. On the same wall further on front there are a harp, a note desk and, more to the center of the room, a Clavecin (panel piano). In the background high window doors leading to a terrace, with views of the park. In the rear corners the hall is limited by glass doors. Behind both sides extend gallery-like rooms with windows to the terrace. On the left one reaches the main entrance of the castle, to the right into the orangery It is early in the afternoon. At the beginning of the curtain and during the first scene, the artist's composition of the musician's composition is performed by the left side.
Count and Countess come from the Salon
The theatre director, Flamand and Olivier re-enter
Flamand sings and plays the sonnet he has just composed
